author: ojiudezue
title: v5.108.33 shipped: Arrival music + welcome scene + departure pause (step 8, option B), WiiM MA twin fix, stuck pages survive NM boot-settle
summary: Arrival music + welcome scene + departure pause (step 8, option B), WiiM MA twin fix, stuck pages survive NM boot-settle
why: Step 8 is the first identity-driven actuation in the arc toward v6.0.0. Option B ships the start and welcome scene now and keeps stop/pause on a conservative ownership rule until the live MA test. The boot-settle fix restores the chatter page that live validation of v5.108.30 showed being swallowed at boot, and rides the same restart.
implications: Shipped ARRIVAL-ENGINE-S8-1, MF-MA-TWIN-WIIM-UUID-1, STUCK-SENSOR-S3B-S1-1 at v5.108.33; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.33.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: After the live 5-min MA test sets the ownership rule (then v6.0.0); if boot-time page counts rise, scope the location key back.

refs.release_notes: Arrival engine acts on counted person arrivals: plays the resident's pick in their own room and waits 15 min, welcome scene in the own room, departure pause. Stop/pause act only while URA owns playback (pending live MA test). Music following matches WiiM MA players. Distinct stuck-sensor kinds no longer collapse in NM boot-settle and a dropped page no longer latches. See README_v5.108.33.md.
